attributes.board_name: Oklahoma State Board of Medical Licensure and Supervision (Physical Therapy Committee)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved providers (any US/Canadian PT licensing board, APTA incl. sections/academies, APTA state chapters, FSBPT, IACET, providers approved by these, accredited PT/PTA programs); other courses need pre-approval for guaranteed credit. Asynchronous courses must include a post-test. Other credit (PDUs): presenting 1.5 PDU per contact hour, post-graduate coursework up to 16 PDU per course, publications, study groups (max 12), clinical instructor (40 h supervision = 1 PDU, max 10), specialty certification (10 initial / 5 recert), residency/fellowship (10 per year, max 20), organization service, APTA membership (1 per year, max 2). In-services, CPR and blood-borne pathogen training are not accepted.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Initially licensed in Oklahoma during the second year of a compliance period: exempt for that first renewal.
rules.audit_note: Licensee signs a statement at renewal; random audits by the Physical Therapy Committee, 30 days to submit proof. Keep records 4 years (two compliance periods). The Board uses Propelus CE Broker as its official CE management system (free basic account). A deficient licensee may not renew until the hours are made up and must earn double the hours in the next period.

topics.who: Ethics education that includes the APTA Guide for Professional Conduct and the APTA Code of Ethics

rules.notes: Compliance period February 1 (odd year) - January 31 (even year). License renewal itself is annual ($90 PT). At least half of the hours must be professional development coursework. Licensees working under 250 hours per year may request a lower requirement.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Same as PT: Board-approved providers (PT licensing boards, APTA and chapters, FSBPT, IACET, accredited PT/PTA programs) or pre-approved courses; PDU credit for other activities per OAC 435:20-9-3.
